reviewed_event.name: iHeartMedia, Inc.
reviewed_event.summary: iHeartMedia reported completion of exchanges involving about $4.8 billion of iHeartCommunications debt. Most maturities were extended by three years and debt was reduced by more than $440 million.

earlier_evidence.summary: iHeartMedia announced exchange offers for iHeartCommunications notes and term loans, launched on November 15. Supporting holders represented about 85.4% of existing debt. At this stage the exchange was proposed, not completed.

reviewed_event.name: Carvana Co.
reviewed_event.summary: S&P raised Carvana's rating to B with a positive outlook, citing stronger operating performance and credit metrics. Its senior secured debt rating rose from B-minus to B.

reviewed_event.name: Boeing Co.
reviewed_event.summary: S&P affirmed Boeing at BBB-minus while retaining negative CreditWatch. A $24.3 billion equity and equity-linked issuance reduced financing pressure, but strike disruption and cash-flow recovery remained concerns.

reviewed_event.name: FAT Brands Inc.
reviewed_event.summary: FAT Brands disclosed receiving acceleration notices on November 17 covering notes issued by four securitization subsidiaries. The trustee declared principal and accrued interest immediately due.

reviewed_event.name: Vroom Inc
reviewed_event.summary: Vroom completed its recapitalization and exited Chapter 11. Convertible notes became equity, leaving the parent without long-term debt. Subsidiary UACC retained securitization and trust-preferred obligations.
